Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
State: National
Category: Insurance
Source URL: https://financialservices.gov.in/pmsby
Reviewed: 2026-11-07
Evidence type: reviewed paraphrase of the linked official source, not a verbatim quotation.

Renewable annual personal accident insurance covering specified accidental death or disability.

Eligibility: Individual account holders aged 18 to 70 at participating banks or post offices may join through one account. Enrolment requires consent to premium auto-debit. Scheme terms determine covered losses; account ownership and age alone do not confirm that insurance is active.

Verified documents / enrolment records: Prescribed enrolment / consent-cum-declaration form; Auto-debit authorization

Evidence and limitations: The Department of Financial Services FAQ lists Rs. 2 lakh for accidental death or specified total permanent disability and Rs. 1 lakh for specified partial permanent disability. It lists an annual premium of Rs. 20, subject to revision. Banks retain enrolment and consent records. The reviewed document list is partial; no blanket Aadhaar requirement is inferred.

Eligibility assessment (NEEDS_INFO): Provide age to check: Age must be at least 18. Provide age to check: Age must be at most 70. Provide participating_account to check: Participating bank or post-office account: Yes. Provide auto_debit_consent to check: Auto-debit consent: Yes. Assessment covers reviewed conditions only; official eligibility is not guaranteed. Confirm current terms with the administering authority. Missing: age, participating_account, auto_debit_consent.

Scheme: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
State: National
Category: Social Welfare
Source URL: https://sansad.in/getFile/loksabhaquestions/annex/182/AU2081_we23z8.pdf?source=pqals
Reviewed: 2026-11-07
Evidence type: reviewed paraphrase of the linked official source, not a verbatim quotation.

Contributory retirement pension scheme with pension options linked to contributions.

Eligibility: The August 2024 Finance Ministry parliamentary answer describes Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 with a savings bank or post-office account. Income-tax payers are not eligible to join from October 1, 2022. This is a national scheme, not a Punjab-only pension.

Verified documents / enrolment records: Complete document list not verified from this source.

Evidence and limitations: The parliamentary answer describes minimum monthly pension choices of Rs. 1,000, 2,000, 3,000, 4,000 or 5,000, depending on joining age and the chosen pension. Contributions are required. This historical official source does not verify a complete document list or subsequent rule changes; applicants should check current official terms.

Scope: Central
Source URL: https://helphub.ladakh.gov.in/landing/pension
Reviewed: 2026-11-09 (Asia/Calcutta)
Evidence type: reviewed paraphrase, not a verbatim quotation.

Pension support for widows in below-poverty-line households.

Eligibility: The Ladakh government lists widows aged at least 40 who belong to a below-poverty-line household.

Coverage is limited to the Ladakh implementation reviewed here; other states and their document requirements need separate review.
